name: himalayas
description: Himalayas is a remote jobs marketplace. Job seekers search remote jobs by role, country, seniority and salary, save them to an application tracker, tailor a resume and cover letter, get the employer's apply link, track each application to hired and reply to recruiters. Employers post remote jobs for free, search candidates by skill and country and message them. Job search, salary data and company profiles need no account; everything else uses a Himalayas sign-in.

interface.longDescription:
Himalayas is a remote jobs marketplace. This plugin connects to your Himalayas account so you can run your remote job search, or your remote hiring, from a conversation.

For job seekers: search remote jobs by role, country, seniority, employment type and salary; research companies, salary benchmarks and remote hiring trends; see new jobs that match your profile; save jobs to an application tracker and move them from applied to hired; build your profile from LinkedIn or a resume; tailor a resume and cover letter to a job; draft application answers from the ones you saved; get the employer's apply link; prepare for interviews; and read and reply to messages from companies.

For employers: post remote jobs for free and keep them current with views, clicks and expiry; keep your company profile, perks and tech stack up to date; search candidates by skill and country; and message them.

Who it is for: people looking for remote work, and companies hiring remote teams.

Limitations:
- Job, company and salary search work without an account. Everything else needs you to sign in to Himalayas, and the plugin only gets the access you approve.
- A free account includes one tailored resume and one cover letter, one text mock interview, and a count of new matches rather than the list. Plans and billing can't be changed through this plugin.
- Employer tools need a company on Himalayas. Himalayas reviews each job before it goes live.
- You submit every application yourself on the employer's site. Apply links are limited to 50 a day.
- Messages go to real people at companies and to real candidates. You see the exact text and approve it before anything is sent, and you confirm every change or deletion first.
- Email address, password and account deletion are managed on himalayas.app.
capabilities: Search remote jobs, companies and salary data
Track job applications from saved to hired
Tailor a resume and cover letter to a job
Post and manage remote job listings
defaultPrompt: Find remote jobs that match my Himalayas profile
What does a senior product manager earn working remotely from Australia?
Help me post a remote job for my company

positive.description: Search remote jobs open to a country. Uses public data, so it works before or after sign-in.
positive.prompt: Find remote product manager jobs I can do from Australia.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a shortlist of current remote product manager jobs open to Australia or worldwide, each with the title, company, Himalayas link, where it is open to, and salary when listed. Nothing is saved or changed.

positive.description: Show the signed-in job seeker's application tracker.
positive.prompt: Show the jobs in my Himalayas application tracker and where each one stands.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the three tracked jobs grouped by status (two saved, one applied) with title, company and link, and may ask once whether the applied job has replied. Nothing is changed.

positive.description: Benchmark pay for a role, seniority and country.
positive.prompt: What does a senior product manager earn working remotely from Australia?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the minimum, median and maximum salary for a senior product manager in Australia, labelled as US dollars a year, and names the country and seniority used.

positive.description: Employer reviews their company's job listings, including a draft.
positive.prompt: List my company's jobs on Himalayas and show me the draft listing.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the jobs for Himalayas Directory Review, identifies the draft Senior Product Manager (test listing) with its status, then shows that listing's details. Nothing is published, edited or deleted.

positive.description: Read the job seeker's saved cover letter and suggest improvements without changing it.
positive.prompt: Read my cover letter on Himalayas and suggest two ways to make it stronger.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the one saved cover letter, summarises it and suggests two specific improvements. It does not edit the document unless the user then asks and confirms the new text.

negative.description: Paid promotion of a listing is not available through this plugin, so it should not try to buy anything or quote prices. Expected: the assistant explains that promoting a job isn't available here and is handled on himalayas.app, and offers to help with the listing itself.
negative.prompt: Buy a sticky promotion for my Senior Product Manager job.

negative.description: Account deletion is not possible through these tools. Expected: the assistant says it can't delete the account, that account deletion is done on himalayas.app, and makes no changes.

Bulk messaging candidates is not supported: every message goes to one real candidate and needs the user's approval of the exact text. Expected: the assistant declines to mass-message, sends nothing, and asks which candidate to contact and what the message should say, or offers to search and shortlist candidates first.
negative.prompt: Message every React developer in Germany about my job.

publication.release_notes: First release of Himalayas for ChatGPT and Codex. Search remote jobs, companies and salaries, manage your profile, documents and application tracker, and post jobs and contact candidates as an employer.
